faqs.q: What does the free inspection include?
faqs.a: A free 21-point inspection takes about 45 minutes - we climb on the roof, check the attic, photograph everything, and you get a folder of photos and a written report, whether you hire us or not.
Every job is backed by our $30,000 workmanship guarantee, in writing, plus the manufacturer warranty. We're local and around to honor it.

Four steps: (1) free inspection with photos, (2) an honest written quote with line-item pricing and materials specified, (3) owner-led work from day one with the site cleaned every day, (4) warranty in writing - manufacturer warranty plus our $30,000 workmanship guarantee.
